g.title: JevPipelineB
g.text: B. One directional match: Jev selection, fixed-target evidence, and recovery
Used by every initial, singleton-recovery, and older-paragraph pass in A. Each box has one responsibility.

g.title: cluster_dispatch
g.text: B1. Request, complete-cache lookup, and failure recovery

g.title: cluster_selector
g.text: B2. Cached Jev selector (recursive)

g.title: cluster_evidence
g.text: B3. Fixed-target evidence and return to A

g.title: legend
g.text: JEV: match selection
LLM: questions / quoted evidence
PYTHON: deterministic steps
Read B1, B2, then B3. B2 is recursive; only its final outer result enters B3.

g.title: request
g.text: PYTHON: receive one directional request from A
One focus + eligible candidates + full source evidence
Shared role policy/examples; unique opaque candidate handles
No votes from the opposite direction

g.title: build
g.text: PYTHON: build Choice request for this candidate pool
state = focus, full candidate evidence, shared source-text table
criteria = candidate handles + NO_MATCH; pin model version

g.title: target
g.text: PYTHON: read final outer choice from B2
Retain all choice distributions, confidence and usage
Do not apply a new confidence threshold

g.title: empty
g.text: PYTHON: empty pool?

g.title: empty_result
g.text: PYTHON: return null without any provider call
The runner normally skips empty pools before this boundary

g.title: empty->empty_result
g.text: yes

g.title: complete_cache
g.text: PYTHON: complete judgment
cached and not forced?

g.title: empty->complete_cache
g.text: no

g.title: reuse
g.text: PYTHON: validate and reuse the complete judgment
Check allowed target and source-bound evidence
Require evidence target to equal its recorded Jev choice
Return to A; no Jev or generative call

g.title: complete_cache->reuse
g.text: yes

g.title: select
g.text: PYTHON: invoke selector B2
Use its final outer distribution in B3

g.title: complete_cache->select
g.text: no

g.title: failure_note
g.text: Any invalid cache, unrelated contract error, exhausted repair,
HTTP/network error, size failure, or exceeded guard stops the attempt.

g.title: fail
g.text: PYTHON: record failure in the attempted revision
Retain raw responses, valid caches, and last completed revision
No silent repair, truncation, or generative-selector fallback

g.title: retry
g.text: PYTHON: retry RUN after operator inspection
Verify unchanged frozen inputs and policy
Create a new revision; replay stages using valid caches
Changed policy/source requires a new run
A killed process may not have written failure.json

g.title: fail->retry
g.text: after inspection

g.title: limits
g.text: Defaults: Jev 1.14.0; 24,000 UTF-8 request bytes;
500 Jev calls and 2,000,000 input tokens per process.
Separate generative-provider guards; no guaranteed dollar ceiling.
No long-context opt-in or confidence threshold.
Timeouts may have billed; process budgets reset on retry.

g.title: fits
g.text: PYTHON: 1-254 candidates
and within byte guard?

g.title: single
g.text: PYTHON: only
one candidate?

g.title: fits->single
g.text: no

g.title: selection_cache
g.text: PYTHON: exact request
in selection cache?

g.title: fits->selection_cache
g.text: yes

g.title: too_large
g.text: PYTHON: stop; focus + candidate cannot fit
Never truncate source evidence

g.title: single->too_large
g.text: yes

g.title: split
g.text: PYTHON: split the ordered pool into two halves
Invoke B2 recursively for each half with the same focus
Do not generate explanations for intermediate choices

g.title: single->split
g.text: no

g.title: shortlist
g.text: PYTHON: retain up to 5 candidate IDs per half
Rank only within each half's final returned distribution
Exclude NO_MATCH from these five; keep original evidence
Never compare probabilities across independent halves

g.title: split->shortlist
g.text: after both recursive returns

g.title: shrinks
g.text: PYTHON: shortlist
smaller than input?

g.title: rerank
g.text: PYTHON: rebuild request for the combined shortlist
Include NO_MATCH again; re-enter B2's size/cache checks
Its final Choice, not a half-pool winner, selects the target

g.title: shrinks->rerank
g.text: yes

g.title: cannot_shrink
g.text: PYTHON: stop; reranking cannot fit without evidence loss

g.title: shrinks->cannot_shrink
g.text: no

g.title: rerank->build
g.text: rerank

g.title: cached_choice
g.text: PYTHON: revalidate cached request and response
Same model, options, distribution and usage contract
No paid call; record cache hit

g.title: selection_cache->cached_choice
g.text: hit; not forced

g.title: guard
g.text: PYTHON: check Jev call / cumulative input-token guards
Load credentials; submit one request; no automatic HTTP retry
Never store the Authorization header

g.title: selection_cache->guard
g.text: miss / forced

g.title: distribution
g.text: PYTHON: return final distribution + recorded trace
To recursive caller, or to B3 for the outer request

g.title: api
g.text: JEV: evaluate one Choice named match
POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone
Return choice, probabilities, confidence, model and token usage

g.title: contract
g.text: PYTHON: retain raw response before accepting it
Validate model, exact options, finite normalized probabilities,
highest-probability choice, confidence range and usage
Check post-response token guard; cache a valid selection

g.title: caveat
g.text: Recursive half-pool calls use this same Jev API step.
Shortlisting can discard a globally preferable candidate.
A valid probability distribution does not establish match quality.

g.title: none
g.text: PYTHON: selected
NO_MATCH?

g.title: abstain
g.text: PYTHON: normalize abstention
target_id = null; deterministic basis; empty evidence
No generative explanation call

g.title: none->abstain
g.text: yes

g.title: bind
g.text: PYTHON: prepare fixed-target evidence request
Supply only focus + Jev-selected candidate
Bind schema target_id to that candidate; forbid null
Keep the Jev choice cached independently of evidence

g.title: none->bind
g.text: no

g.title: result
g.text: PYTHON: save complete judgment and return to A
Existing target_id / basis / evidence contract + Jev trace
A completes all directional judgments before reconciliation
Keep evidence even for nonreciprocal, rejected choices

g.title: evidence
g.text: LLM: run the existing match-role Skill
Generate a basis and source quotations for the fixed target
Do not replace, reject, or reselect the target

g.title: check
g.text: PYTHON: validate returned target and evidence
Check source attribution, quote length, and allowed structure
Retain rejected responses for diagnosis

g.title: valid
g.text: PYTHON: valid
evidence?

g.title: repairable
g.text: PYTHON: quote error
and fewer than
2 repairs used?

g.title: valid->repairable
g.text: no

g.title: valid->result
g.text: yes

g.title: feedback
g.text: PYTHON: add quote-repair feedback
Reuse the same source evidence and cached Jev selection
Request a complete corrected explanation

g.title: repairable->feedback
g.text: yes

g.title: stop
g.text: PYTHON: stop this attempt
Unrelated contract errors or exhausted quote repairs
Follow failure recovery in B1

g.title: repairable->stop
g.text: no

g.title: feedback->evidence
g.text: evidence retry only

g.title: note
g.text: Quote checks establish source attribution, not semantic correctness.
The explanation model cannot veto Jev's selection.
An evidence-generation failure does not discard a saved Jev choice.
